solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Bug found in metal perch?

parts.note: silver is a precious metal
a perch is a kind of freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Someone discovers an insect lurking in a metal perch.
explanation.definitionFit: The silverfish is a small wingless insect, and bug is a loose everyday word for any insect.

clue.text: Food needing a bit of sauce in the past

indicators.note: a bit of the word sauce means just its opening letter is taken

parts.note: something that happened in the past happened ago, as in years ago

explanation.surface: A dish that once needed a dash of sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: Sago is a starchy foodstuff from palm pith, used in milk puddings.

clue.text: Greedy person underpinning hunger for white meat

indicators.note: in a down clue a piece underpinning another sits below it, so it comes second

parts.note: to long for something is to hunger for it
a greedy person is called a pig

explanation.surface: A glutton's appetite for chicken or turkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hunger' is a verb here (to long), not an appetite noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Long pig is an old term, said to come from Pacific cannibals, for human flesh as food, a pale meat.

clue.text: Fiddling car tax avenges excesses

indicators.note: fiddling with something is tampering, so these letters are tampered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone cheats on vehicle tax to pay back what they see as government overreach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fiddling' suggests tax fraud, but it asks for CAR TAX AVENGES to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Extravagances are acts of overspending or going too far, which are excesses.

clue.text: Makes footballers be quiet — one's working inside

parts.note: FA is the Football Association, the body for English footballers
sh is the call to be quiet

indicators.note: inside says the word for working goes within the letters for one's

parts.note: one's is read as one is, giving I and S
a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: Telling footballers to hush while a teammate is busy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' is expanded as 'one is', I + S, and ON goes inside it to make IONS.
explanation.definitionFit: To fashion something is to shape or make it, so fashions is a synonym of makes.

clue.text: Dross incorporating new words commonly used

indicators.note: incorporating means the first word takes the next inside it

parts.note: slag is the waste dross left from smelting metal

explanation.surface: Rubbish mixed with fresh everyday vocabulary.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang is informal vocabulary in common colloquial use rather than standard speech.

clue.text: Cut back before hardship finally becomes a potential source of pain

indicators.note: back says the word for cut is read the other way round

parts.note: to saw is to cut

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of hardship

explanation.surface: A reduction followed by trouble that ends up hurting.
explanation.definitionFit: A wasp can sting, so it is a creature that might give you pain.

clue.text: Embraced alterations to depot after a day

indicators.note: after says the rearranged depot follows A and D
alterations to the word depot rearrange its letters

explanation.surface: Changes to a warehouse are welcomed the next day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Embraced' reads as a hug, but means taken up as one's own; 'after' puts the anagram behind A and D.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt an idea or cause is to embrace it, so adopted matches embraced.

clue.text: Recruitment agencies staffed by journalists?

parts.note: the press means journalists, and teams of them would be gangs; historically such gangs forcibly recruited sailors

explanation.surface: Employment firms run by reporters.
explanation.definitionFit: Press gangs were naval squads that forced men into service, a brutal form of recruitment.

clue.text: Man eating tail of marine carnivore

indicators.note: eating means the man takes the next piece inside him

parts.note: a gent is a man

indicators.note: tail of picks the final letter of marine

explanation.surface: A man munching on the end of a seafood meat-eater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'marine carnivore' reads as one phrase, but marine only supplies its tail.
explanation.definitionFit: The genet is a small cat-like mammal of Africa and Europe that eats meat.

clue.text: Soft rock offering Coronation Street's sound quality?

parts.note: Coronation Street is a long-running British TV soap opera, so it is a soap's
tone is the quality of a sound

explanation.surface: Music that suits the sound of a TV drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soft rock' suggests a gentle music genre; it is the mineral.
explanation.definitionFit: Soapstone is a soft talc-rich rock used for carving.

clue.text: Last article included in holiday studies

indicators.note: included in means the article sits within the other two words

parts.note: a stay is a short holiday somewhere
a course is a programme of studies
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: The final item is part of vacation reading.
explanation.definitionFit: To last is to endure to the end, which is the idiom of seeing a race or task through.

clue.text: Chap at devotions worrying it's a kind of bug

parts.note: a chap at his devotions is a man who is praying

indicators.note: worrying means the letters of it's are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A man at prayer frets that some insect is about.
explanation.definitionFit: The praying mantis is a predatory insect that holds its forelegs as if in prayer.

clue.text: Call up quote, accepting father's set free

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to call someone something is to name them

indicators.note: accepting means the word for quote takes the father inside it

parts.note: to cite is to quote
pa is a familiar word for father

explanation.surface: Phone someone and quote them while dad is freed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns NAME into EMAN; 'Call up' looks like a phone call.
explanation.definitionFit: To emancipate is to liberate someone from slavery or restriction.

clue.text: Jet fighter almost precipitated a headache

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian jet fighter

indicators.note: almost means the word for precipitated loses its last letter

parts.note: if it rained, water precipitated from the sky

explanation.surface: A fighter plane nearly brought on a headache.
explanation.definitionFit: A migraine is a severe recurring kind of headache.

clue.text: Somewhat underpaid at shifting back areas for entertainment

indicators.note: back says the run of letters is read in reverse
somewhat means only part of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: Poorly paid workers moving behind the scenes at venues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somewhat' takes AIDATS from underpAID AT Shifting, and 'back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Stadia are large arenas for sport and shows, places of entertainment.

clue.text: Fit new prams to carry oxygen, lacking information

indicators.note: to carry means the rearranged prams hold the next piece inside
new means the letters of prams are made into a fresh order
lacking means oxygen goes without the letters for information

parts.note: gen is slang for information

explanation.surface: New prams fitted with oxygen tanks but no instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' makes PARSM from PRAMS, which carries OXY (oxygen less GEN).
explanation.definitionFit: A paroxysm is a sudden attack or outburst, as in a fit of coughing.

clue.text: Drunk certain to be missing one drink

indicators.note: drunk means the letters of certain are scrambled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone sure they had one drink too many.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of CERTAIN, with I (one) taken out ('to be missing'), are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Nectar is the drink of the gods, and loosely any delicious drink.

clue.text: A wicked thing in most of blackjack establishments?

indicators.note: in means the first pieces go within the shortened weapon
most of means the word for blackjack loses its last letter

parts.note: a blackjack is a cosh, a short club
a sin is a wicked thing

explanation.surface: A bad act involving card games at gambling houses.
explanation.walkthrough: Blackjack looks like the card game, which suits the casino scene, but here it is the club.
explanation.definitionFit: Casinos are establishments for gambling, where blackjack is played.

clue.text: Bug expert caught in left arm

indicators.note: caught in means the expert sits within the other letters

parts.note: a wing is an arm of a building or organisation
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: An insect specialist trapped in someone's left arm.
explanation.definitionFit: The lacewing is an insect with delicate netted wings.

clue.text: Provide encouragement through spin, perhaps, and anger

indicators.note: perhaps means spin is one possible arrangement of these letters

parts.note: ire is anger

explanation.surface: Motivate people with political spin and fury.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspire is to fill someone with encouragement to act.

clue.text: Eating 12, for example, irons out vices weirdly

indicators.note: weirdly means the letters of irons out vices are put in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Something feeding on bugs straightens out its bad habits strangely.
explanation.definitionFit: Insectivorous means feeding on insects, of which the bug at 12 is an example.

clue.text: One couldn't be bothered keeping to the bridle roads

indicators.note: keeping to means the run of letters is kept inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A lazy rider sticks to the bridleways.
explanation.definitionFit: An idler is a lazy person who cannot be bothered to work.

clue.text: Solutions provided by island parliament

definitions.meaning: the solutions to a test or puzzle are its ...
the House of ... is the parliament of the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Answers from an island legislature.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man is a self-governing island between Britain and Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Keys give answers to puzzles, and the Keys is shorthand for the Manx House of Keys.

clue.text: Relatively fair game for abuse?

parts.note: a fairground game where things are thrown at a figure, the figure named as a relative, also a person everyone attacks

explanation.surface: A family member everyone feels free to criticise.
explanation.definitionFit: An Aunt Sally is a fairground target for thrown sticks, hence anyone set up to be attacked.

clue.text: Bring up level for the audience

indicators.note: for the audience means the word is as heard by listeners

parts.note: to raze a building is to level it to the ground

explanation.surface: Lift the standard so spectators notice.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise children is to bring them up.

clue.text: Delivery of drugs to provide comfort

indicators.note: delivery here is the way words are spoken out

parts.note: E is ecstasy, so Es are ecstasy tablets

explanation.surface: Bringing medicine to relieve suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease is to relieve pain or worry, giving comfort.

clue.text: People with brass elephants?

definitions.meaning: players of brass instruments such as the bugle
elephants make a loud call known as trumpeting

explanation.surface: Musicians from a band, or a herd of loud beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: Trumpeters play a brass instrument, and an elephant trumpets, so either is a trumpeter.
